items.title: CISA, FBI and Partners Warn Organizations of SafePay Ransomware Actors Targeting Multiple Critical Infrastructure Sectors
CVE-2026-129448: exploited vulnerability in Apache Roller
items.note: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.

items.title: CVE-2026-123890: exploited vulnerability in Broadcom VMware vCenter
items.note: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

items.title: CVE-2025-42884: exploited vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver
items.note: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

items.title: CVE-2026-76466: exploited vulnerability in Cisco Expressway Series
items.note: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

items.title: CVE-2024-10441: exploited vulnerability in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM)
items.note: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

items.title: CVE-2026-40217: exploited vulnerability in BerriAI LiteLLM
items.note: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

items.title: CVE-2026-90817: exploited vulnerability in Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap)
items.note: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash.

items.title: CVE-2026-90436: exploited vulnerability in Apache Axis
items.note: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

items.title: CVE-2026-115731: exploited vulnerability in Perforce Puppet Enterprise
items.note: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vu

items.title: CVE-2026-114713: exploited vulnerability in UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd
items.note: UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

items.title: CVE-2026-123039: exploited vulnerability in Check Point Multiple Products
items.note: Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

items.title: CVE-2026-124194: exploited vulnerability in Microsoft Office
items.note: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

items.title: CVE-2026-111793: exploited vulnerability in Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder
items.note: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

items.title: CVE-2026-20320: exploited vulnerability in Cisco BroadWorks
items.note: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-111560: exploited vulnerability in Barracuda Networks Multiple Products
items.note: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606

items.title: CVE-2022-43931: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Remote Desktop Functionality in Synology VPN Plus Server before 1.4.3-0534 and 1.4.4-0635 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via unspecified vectors.

items.title: CVE-2023-1497: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Simple and Nice Shopping Cart Script 1.0. It has been rated as critical. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file uploaderm.php. The manipulation of the argument submit leads to unrestricted upload. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The identifier VDB-223397 was assigned to this vulnerability.

items.title: CVE-2024-29241: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Missing authorization vulnerability in System webapi component in Synology Surveillance Station before 9.2.0-9289 and 9.2.0-11289 allows remote authenticated users to obtain non-sensitive information, write sensitive configurations in DSM, and reboot or shutdown NAS via unspecified vectors.

items.title: CVE-2024-38795: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Emraan Cheema ListingPro listingpro-plugin allows SQL Injection.This issue affects ListingPro: from n/a through 2.9.4.

items.title: CVE-2024-10443: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability in Task Manager component in Synology BeePhotos before 1.0.2-10026 and 1.1.0-10053 and Synology Photos before 1.6.2-0720 and 1.7.0-0795 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

items.title: CVE-2012-10023: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in FreeFloat FTP Server version 1.0.0. The server fails to properly validate input passed to the USER command, allowing remote attackers to overwrite memory and potentially execute arbitrary code. The flaw is triggered by sending an overly long username string, which overflows the buffer allocated for user authentication.

items.title: CVE-2012-10030: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: FreeFloat FTP Server contains multiple critical design flaws that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to upload arbitrary files to sensitive system directories. The server accepts empty credentials, defaults user access to the root of the C:\ drive, and imposes no restrictions on file type or destination path. items.note: Multiple D-Link DIR-series routers, including DIR-110, DIR-412, DIR-600, DIR-610, DIR-615, DIR-645, and DIR-815 firmware version 1.03, contain a vulnerability in the service.cgi endpoint that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands without authentication. The flaw stems from improper input handling in the EVENT=CHECKFW parameter, which is passed directly to the system shell without sanitization. items.note: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in the St. Joe ERP system ("圣乔ERP系统") that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via crafted HTTP POST requests to the login endpoint. The application fails to properly sanitize user-supplied input before incorporating it into SQL queries, enabling direct manipulation of the backend database. items.title: CVE-2025-34204: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Vasion Print (formerly PrinterLogic) Virtual Appliance Host and Application (VA and SaaS deployments) contains multiple Docker containers that run primary application processes (for example PHP workers, Node.js servers and custom binaries) as the root user. This increases the blast radius of a container compromise and enables lateral movement and host compromise when a container is breached.

items.title: CVE-2025-34206: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Vasion Print (formerly PrinterLogic) Virtual Appliance Host and Application (VA and SaaS deployments) mount host configuration and secret material under /var/www/efs_storage into many Docker containers with overly-permissive filesystem permissions. Files such as secrets.env, GPG-encrypted blobs in .secrets, MySQL client keys, and application session files are accessible from multiple containers. items.title: CVE-2025-34217: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Vasion Print (formerly PrinterLogic) Virtual Appliance Host and Application (VA/SaaS deployments) contain an undocumented 'printerlogic' user with a hardcoded SSH public key in '~/.ssh/authorized_keys' and a sudoers rule granting the printerlogic_ssh group 'NOPASSWD: ALL'. Possession of the matching private key gives an attacker root access to the appliance.

items.title: Too Lost
items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog
items.note: In November 2026, an unauthorised party claimed to have obtained data from the music distributor for independent artists, Too Lost. The data contained 724k unique email addresses belonging to artists, their collaborators and fans. Some records also contained bcrypt password hashes, while a small subset included partial credit card data (last 4 digits and card type), identity verification information (in some cases, passport, driver's licence or national ID numbers), and payouts made to artists.

items.title: Careers360
items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog
items.note: In November 2026, data allegedly taken from the Indian education and careers platform Careers360 appeared on a public hacking forum. The 22M records included 3.6M unique email addresses alongside names, phone numbers, genders and caste categories, and most also contained students' entrance exam results, including ranks and marks.

items.title: AfD
items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog
items.note: In September 2026, the German political party Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) suffered a data breach which exposed 345k unique email addresses. The following month, hundreds of gigabytes of data containing hundreds of thousands of emails and attachments was published online, with searchable AI-generated summaries and downloadable original files.

The incident exposed hundreds of thousands of customer records, including 118k unique email addresses alongside names, phone numbers, postal addresses and booking details.

items.title: Neogen
items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog
items.note: In August 2026, the food and animal safety organisation Neogen was the target of a ShinyHunters "pay or leak" extortion attempt. The group later published data it claimed had been obtained from Neogen. items.title: Data broker privacy watch
items.note: Recheck broker opt-out results every 30-90 days; many brokers repopulate data. Keep broker name, profile URL, date requested, and confirmation emails.

items.title: Unwanted software / bloatware watch
items.note: Watch for software that changes browser settings, injects ads, bundles unwanted offers, hides removal paths, exaggerates cleanup claims, or uses misleading install prompts.

items.title: Remote-access scam reminder
items.source: WireShield guidance from FTC/CISA-style scam prevention
items.note: Treat unexpected requests to install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, UltraViewer, RustDesk, or ScreenConnect as high risk, especially when paired with refunds, bank warnings, crypto, or gift cards.
